title: ControlLoopTick
description: Per-iteration record of a ControlLoop: what was sensed, what was decided under which exact policy digest, what was done through which ExecutionDecision, how it verified, and the receipt. Verdict vocabulary is the OPS ternary (ok/sad/bad) — ticks are operations; claim-shaped content is NEVER scored here (claims take the 5-axis verdict model on CausalHypothesis). Invariants: policyDigest must equal the referenced ControlLoop's policyDigest at tick time (cross-checked by the family validator); a work tick must carry an executionDecisionRef (enforced by if/then — acting without a gate decision is exactly the membrane bypass this contract exists to forbid); anomaly.escalated must be true whenever anomaly.adjustmentCount exceeds the loop's retry budget (validator-enforced).

specVersion.description: Epistemic-kernel contract version, pinned. Changing this const is a contract change.

loopRef.description: ControlLoop URN this tick belongs to.

tickNumber.description: Monotonic tick counter within the loop.

kind.description: Tick kind. idle ticks are first-class (the loop is a service with no End state); escalation ticks record hand-off to the loop's escalationRef after the retry budget is exhausted.

policyDigest.description: Digest of the policy actually in force during this tick. Invariant: must equal the referenced ControlLoop's policyDigest (family validator cross-check). This is the staleness-attribution linchpin — behavior is never attributed to an unversioned policy.

executionDecisionRef.description: ExecutionDecision URN issued by the capability membrane authorizing this tick's act phase. Required for work ticks (enforced by if/then).

items.description: URN or stable reference of a sensed input (metrics window, event batch, eval input).

senseRefs.description: What the sense phase consumed. Required (empty allowed) so ticks state their evidence posture explicitly.

items.description: URN or stable reference of an action artifact (EffectRecord, schedule change, policy proposal).

actRefs.description: What the act phase produced. Required (empty allowed); idle ticks carry an empty array.

verdict.description: Verify-phase outcome in the OPS ternary. ok: behaved as intended; sad: degraded but within budget; bad: violated an invariant or budget. Never used for claim-shaped content.

receiptRef.description: URN of the sealed receipt for this tick (ReasoningReceipt, AgentMachineReceipt, or equivalent). Every tick is receipt-backed — an unreceipted tick is the silent failure the chaos fabric treats as a first-class defect.

detected.description: Whether the verify phase detected an anomaly this tick.

adjustmentCount.description: Automatic adjustments already attempted for the current incident, including this tick.

escalated.description: Whether this incident has been escalated to the loop's escalationRef. Invariant (validator-enforced): must be true when adjustmentCount exceeds the loop's retryBudget.maxAdjustmentsPerIncident.

anomaly.description: Anomaly bookkeeping that makes the retry budget auditable per tick.
